# Hotel Nakshatra & Resort — Khargone, Madhya Pradesh

## Rooms & Pricing

- **Total Rooms**: 60 guest rooms across four categories
- **Executive Room**: ₹2,999/night — max 2 guests
- **Deluxe Room**: ₹3,799/night — max 3 guests
- **Family Room**: ₹7,499/night — max 4 guests
- **Suite Room**: ₹6,499/night — max 3 guests
- All rooms: AC, private bathroom, hot water, WiFi, TV, daily housekeeping, in-room dining, power backup

## Facilities & Amenities

- **Swimming Pools**: Ground-floor swimming pool (included for all registered staying guests) + exclusive 3rd-floor private pool suites for luxury couple stays
- **Wedding & Banquet Venues**: ~5,500 sq ft grand indoor air-conditioned banquet hall (Nakshatra Grand Hall, capacity 1,200 guests) + lush open-air wedding garden & celebration lawns
- **Dining**: In-house multi-cuisine restaurant — North Indian, Chinese, Continental, Mughlai, with vegetarian options. Meal plans available (room-only, breakfast, half-board, full-board)
- **Parking**: Khargone's biggest dedicated on-site parking area for 200+ vehicles with 24/7 security (free)
- **Connectivity**: High-speed WiFi (50+ Mbps), power backup, 24-hour front desk
- **Recreation**: Kids play area, outdoor sports, resort grounds

## Banquet & Events

Nakshatra Grand Hall:
- ~5,500 sq ft indoor AC banquet hall
- Capacity: up to 1,200 guests
- Event types: weddings, receptions, engagements, birthday parties, anniversary celebrations, corporate conferences, meetings, social gatherings
- Adjacent open-air wedding garden lawns for ceremonies and outdoor events
- On-site: 60 guest rooms for wedding party accommodation, multi-cuisine catering, free parking
